comment: The implementation chapter does not reference widely deployed open source tools such as KoboToolbox, ODK, CommCare, and OpenSRP that are already in active use across Sub-Saharan Africa. Countries implementing DPI-H will frequently be building on or integrating with these existing tools rather than starting from scratch. The absence of any mapping between these tools and the architecture components leaves a significant practical gap.
